lines.text: Many learners say: It depends of the weather.
Better: It depends on the weather.
Say depend on. Not depend of.

data.why: Say depend on. Not depend of.

native.tip: “取决于”的固定搭配是 “depend on”，不是 depend of。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “It depends of the weather.”？😅 “取决于”要用 depend on：“It depends on the weather.”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“depend on”。depend 后接 on！免费测验在这里：{link}
